methodology.scope: The seven manually adjudicated score-bearing A claims plus the one B and one C claim from ir-score-bearing-adjudication-v1.
methodology.target_rule: For A claims the smallest score-bearing component is the authoritative extraction target. Supporting distribution, prescription, contract, capacity, growth, or one-period performance facts cannot substitute for it.
methodology.success_rule: Vision must recover and correctly route all seven A components, reject both recovered B/C claims, preserve at least 90% split-vote repeatability, and keep score-route conflict below 10%.

claims.claim: Redcap Tour reports that 2021 Q3 revenue fell 7% and operating profit fell 33% year over year, while rental-car profit fell 40% and the travel operating loss narrowed 51%.
claims.gold_rationale: This is an ordinary two-point performance comparison without persistent margin behavior or explicit MOAT-anchor erosion.

claims.claim: AVACO shows cumulative sputter orders rising about 74.9 times to KRW 674.6 billion and describes a long trust relationship with a global display customer.
claims.gold_rationale: Cumulative orders and customer references do not directly establish renewal, repeat ordering by the same customer, retention, churn, or installed-base reuse.

claims.claim: Eugene Technology's operating margin was 24.7%, 12.1%, 30.5%, 11.8%, and 28.9% from 2020 Q3 through 2021 Q3, showing large five-quarter volatility.
claims.score_bearing_component: Eugene Technology's operating margin moved 24.7%, 12.1%, 30.5%, 11.8%, and 28.9% over five consecutive quarters.
claims.gold_rationale: The five comparable quarterly margin observations directly expose multi-period instability.

claims.claim: HK inno.N states that its K-CAB product ranks number one by market share in the peptic-ulcer drug market.
claims.score_bearing_component: HK inno.N identifies K-CAB as the number-one product by market share in the peptic-ulcer drug market.
claims.gold_rationale: The issuer-owned product and explicit category rank are the minimum realized MARKET_SHARE component.

claims.claim: HK inno.N states that its Condition product continues to rank number one by market share in the hangover-relief category.
claims.score_bearing_component: HK inno.N states that Condition continues to hold the number-one market share in hangover-relief products.
claims.gold_rationale: The maintained number-one category share is authoritative; convenience-store distribution is support only.

claims.claim: Global Tax Free is identified as the domestic number-one tax-refund operator with a 70-75% market share.
claims.score_bearing_component: Global Tax Free is identified as the domestic number-one tax-refund operator with 70-75% market share.
claims.gold_rationale: The page directly links the issuer to a numeric share and leader rank.

claims.claim: EuBiologics states that its Euvichol oral-cholera vaccine supplies more than 90% of the UNICEF public market.
claims.score_bearing_component: EuBiologics states that Euvichol supplies more than 90% of the UNICEF public market.
claims.gold_rationale: The explicit public-market share is authoritative; contract, capacity, and supply volume are support only.

claims.claim: EuBiologics directly produces EcML in E. coli, reducing production time and manufacturing cost versus GLA, which requires more than 30 synthesis and purification steps and has high manufacturing cost.
claims.score_bearing_component: EuBiologics directly produces EcML in E. coli, reducing production time and manufacturing cost versus GLA's 30-plus synthesis and purification steps.
claims.gold_rationale: The direct issuer-process comparison links fewer steps and less time to lower manufacturing cost.

claims.claim: BIO-FD&C realized profits for eleven consecutive years from 2011 through 2023 and presents annual operating margins for the period.
claims.score_bearing_component: BIO-FD&C realized profits for eleven consecutive years.
claims.gold_rationale: The consecutive profitability statement and multi-year margin observations are authoritative; revenue CAGR is support only.
